nodes.description: Public constant uint256 price multiplier (1e10) used to scale Chainlink 8-decimal answers to 18 decimals.
AggregatorInterface public state variable holding the address of the adapted Chainlink aggregator.
Constructor that stores the aggregator address into the oracle state variable.
External view function that reads oracle.latestAnswer(), coerces it to uint256 and applies the price multiplier.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow require check.
SafeMath division with division-by-zero require check.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow require check.
SafeMath addition with overflow require check.
SafeMath modulo with zero-divisor require check.
External interface function that returns the latest int256 oracle answer; invoked by read().
External interface function returning the int256 answer for a given roundId.
External interface function returning the uint256 timestamp for a given roundId.
Unsafe arithmetic: int256 oracle answer cast directly to uint256 (negative answers become huge values) and then multiplied by PRICE_MULTIPLIER.
AggregatorInterface constructor parameter used to initialize the oracle state variable.
Local uint256 in read() holding the raw casted oracle answer before multiplier application.

Denominator operand of SafeMath.div.
Minuend operand of SafeMath.sub.

First uint256 operand of SafeMath.add.

uint256 round identifier consumed by AggregatorInterface.getAnswer.
uint256 round identifier consumed by AggregatorInterface.getTimestamp.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _oracle is written into the oracle state variable.
read() reads the oracle state variable to invoke latestAnswer on it.
Return value of oracle.latestAnswer() flows into read() for conversion.
read() performs the unsafe int256-to-uint256 cast and multiplication, reaching the unsafe operation.
Local oracleOutput carries the casted raw answer into the unsafe multiplication.
PRICE_MULTIPLIER state constant is used inside read() to scale the answer.
SafeMath.mul is invoked by read() to apply the price multiplier.
read() makes an external callback into the oracle contract via latestAnswer().
Parameter a_mul flows into SafeMath.mul multiplication.
Parameter b_mul flows into SafeMath.mul multiplication.
Parameter a_div flows into SafeMath.div division.
Parameter b_div flows into SafeMath.div division and zero check.
Parameter a_sub flows into SafeMath.sub subtraction.
Parameter b_sub flows into SafeMath.sub underflow check.
Parameter a_add flows into SafeMath.add addition.
Parameter b_add flows into SafeMath.add addition.
Parameter a_mod flows into SafeMath.mod operation.
Parameter b_mod flows into SafeMath.mod zero check.
Parameter roundId_getAnswer is used to look up an answer in getAnswer.
Parameter roundId_getTimestamp is used to look up a timestamp in getTimestamp.
